qwtivx28x.name: Bjorn
qwtivx28x.role: 9th-century Norse raid leader displaced into modern New York
qwtivx28x.coreConflict: Sovereignty and provider identity in a world where provision depends on paperwork, money, transit, appointments, and administrative legitimacy.
qwtivx28x.characterRule: Functionally illiterate and technologically helpless, but never stupid. He interprets keys, contracts, property, signatures, doors, institutions, and procedure as questions of sovereignty and responsibility.
qwtivx28x.arc: Moves from defending authority through old-world competence toward defending his people's right to belong inside systems he does not control.
qwtivx28x.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

ywg8bdjvl.name: Gunnar
ywg8bdjvl.coreConflict: Turning an overwhelming modern city into navigable terrain without surrendering his own framework.
ywg8bdjvl.characterRule: Not Bjorn's sidekick. He studies routes, bottlenecks, clerks, signals, infrastructure, transactions, loopholes, and procedures until they become usable patterns.
ywg8bdjvl.dialoguePattern: Modern explanation -> confident agreement -> catastrophic-sounding literal interpretation -> later proof that part of Gunnar's framing was useful.
ywg8bdjvl.arc: Becomes increasingly capable of steering the group through modern systems, especially transit and public-space logic.
ywg8bdjvl.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

19020mp40.name: Carrie
19020mp40.role: DTI social worker/caseworker and primary institutional bridge
19020mp40.coreConflict: Whether procedure exists to contain people or can be bent to protect them.
19020mp40.characterRule: Fast, sarcastic, distinctly New York, highly competent, and never merely the annoyed straight woman. Her action language is administrative fluency: forms, deadlines, wording, supervisors, loopholes, and temporary statuses.
19020mp40.arc: Begins by managing an impossible case through procedure and becomes a protector increasingly willing to bend or weaponize process on the Vikings' behalf.
19020mp40.openDecision: Full legal/display name is not yet locked.
19020mp40.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

bvfeqb22e.name: Silas
bvfeqb22e.role: Tech-bro neighbor and self-appointed cultural interpreter
bvfeqb22e.coreConflict: He initially converts the Vikings into content, data, brand, and opportunity rather than relating to them as people.
bvfeqb22e.characterRule: Begins irritating and exploitative but must not remain a pure antagonist or permanent content-extractor villain.
bvfeqb22e.arc: Annoying-to-endearing: gradually becomes genuinely connected to the Vikings and useful to their social world without losing his ridiculous optimization instincts.
bvfeqb22e.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

magister.name: Dr. Aris Thorne / Magister
magister.role: Museum curator associated with the Museum of the Seafaring North
magister.coreConflict: The academic gaze: treating living people as specimens, measurements, primary sources, and access opportunities rather than fully seeing them.
magister.characterRule: Not locked as a major recurring villain. May reappear and may ultimately support the Vikings.
magister.openDecision: Exact return and long-term role remain unresolved.
magister.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance where depicted.

dfh4bu71y.name: DTI Floor Supervisor
dfh4bu71y.characterRule: Bureaucracy embodied rather than evil. Conflict comes from clean fields, compliant files, approved statuses, precedent, and reviewable decisions.
dfh4bu71y.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

tnvx3hlo0.name: The Kin
tnvx3hlo0.role: Temporal migrant household sharing the Bushwick studio
tnvx3hlo0.characterRule: People with their own adaptation experiences, not background Viking texture. They turn temporary shelter into the Safe Cave through collective habits, food, objects, improvisation, ritual, and physical occupation of space.
tnvx3hlo0.openDecision: Exact number may remain comedically ambiguous. Eirik, Astrid, and Ivar are working names, not fully locked.
tnvx3hlo0.canonRule: Released StarSplitterVisions art controls appearance. Stale neo-noir/cyberpunk descriptions in source exports are non-canon.

qgp7joghv.role: New York civic and neighborhood texture
qgp7joghv.characterRule: Bodega clerks, MTA agents, commuters, delivery workers, guards, neighbors, and locals generally treat Vikings as another sidewalk problem. Flat indifference is a recurring joke and pressure system.
